craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta address to vastness. Same pour as v03, rhyming not copying: v03 softened, here held — comma→dash holds the pair, end-dash→colon lands on hail. Bright: withdrawn touch, brimming nectar, Vast. Rejected: 'spells' for 'spell-shaped' — killed: breaks the māyā-svarūpa compound L0 carries whole; 'vastness' abstraction — killed: vibhave is address (Vast!), not weather. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: To touch reined in and yoked, to nectar brimming full —
to sky-and-spell-shaped Vast, to Śambhu: hail.
l4.sanskrit_cite: saṃhṛtasparśayogāya sampūrṇāmṛtasūtaye viyanmāyāsvarūpāya vibhave śambhave namaḥ
